optimization_recommendations: Day 1: Switch roast duck dinner to cheaper alternative saves 137 CNY/person. Or accept as welcome splurge (within 400 CNY ceiling).
Day 4: Skip or reschedule hotpot dinner due to train conflict (17:30 vs 17:37). Eat lunch heartily instead.
Day 7: Choose People's Park + teahouse (256 CNY total) instead of Qingcheng Mountain (394 CNY). Saves 138 CNY/person.
Day 13 HIGH PRIORITY: Skip Oriental Pearl Tower (150 CNY) - Pudong skyline view from The Bund is free and equally spectacular. Reduces Day 13 total by 150 CNY/person.
Day 13: Reduce shopping from 250 CNY to 100 CNY by skipping Tianzifang purchases. Save 150 CNY.
Day 14: Substitute Bianyi Fang roast duck lunch (124 CNY) with simple meal (50 CNY) since Da Dong dinner is also roast duck. Save 74 CNY/person.
Day 14: Skip Wangfujing shopping (75 CNY) on final Beijing day - buy souvenirs at airport instead.
Day 12: Downgrade reunion dinner from Ji Shi (150 CNY) to good neighborhood restaurant (80-100 CNY). Save 50-70 CNY/person.
All Xi'an days: Xi'an has the cheapest food (10-68 CNY meals) - lean into this to compensate for expensive Shanghai days.
Jade commute optimization: Jade's 3 domestic flights cost ~6932 CNY. If any class can be moved to non-mandatory, significant savings available. Otherwise accept as fixed cost.
